summary: Ronald Y. Nakasone is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned his PhD from the University of Wisconsin-Madison (~1975–1980) under Minoru Kiyota. He held positions at the Pacific School of Religion and the Institute of Buddhist Studies (assistant professor).

Rong Ma is a scholar of Tibetology and other fields. He earned a doctorate in social geography from Brown University (~1984–1987) and served at Peking University as Director of the Institute of Sociology and Anthropology (~1990–2000) and Harvard University (~2000–2001).

Rongdao Lai works in Buddhist studies, Sinology, and religious studies. She earned her PhD from McGill University (~2007–2013) under G. Victor Sōgen Hori and Robin D. S. Yates, and was a visiting fellow at the Center for Chinese Studies (~2010–2011).

Rory Brendan Lindsay is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at the University of Toronto (~2007–2011) and earned his PhD at Harvard University (~2013–2018), where his doctoral supervisor was Leonard van der Kuijp.
Rory Mackenzie is a scholar in Buddhist studies and religious studies who completed doctoral studies under Peter Harvey (~2000–2006). He held a teaching post at International Christian College.
Rosan Ikeda is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Komazawa University (~1960–1970). He later served as a professor at Komazawa University (~1989–2011).
Rosane Rocher is a scholar of Indology and linguistics who studied at the Free University of Brussels (~1954–1965). She served as a professor at the University of Pennsylvania (~1970–2005).
Rosemarie Fuchs is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar who studied under Katia Holmes (1978) and Khenpo Tsültrim Gyamtso Rinpoche. She has served as a member of the Marpa Translation Committee.
Rosemarie Lühr is a scholar in linguistics and Indology. She held academic posts at the University of Giessen (~1990–1994) and the University of Jena (~1994–2013).

Rosina Pastore is an Indology and religious studies scholar who completed her PhD at the University of Lausanne (~2017–2022) under supervisors Maya Burger and Stefania Cavaliere. She also served as an assistant and PhD candidate at Lausanne (~2017–2022).
Ross Bolleter is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under traditional teachers Robert Aitken (~1981–1997) and John Tarrant (~1985–1995).
Roy Rappaport was a scholar of religious studies and other fields who studied at Columbia University (~1959–1966). He held a post at the University of Michigan from ~1965 to 1997.

Roy Tzohar is a scholar of philosophy, Indology, and Buddhist studies. He studied at Tel Aviv University (~1998–2005) and earned his PhD at Columbia University (~2005–2011) under Gary A. Tubb, later holding a post at Tel Aviv University (~2011).

Roy W. Perrett is a philosopher and Indologist who studied at the University of Canterbury (~1970–1974) and University of Otago (~1978–1981). He held posts at Massey University (~1989–2001), University of Hawaii (~2001–2008), and University of Melbourne.

Royall Tyler is a scholar of Japanology and religious studies who studied at Harvard University (~1953–1957) and Columbia University (~1964–1977). He held posts at the University of Oslo (~1984–1990) and the Australian National University (~1990–2000).
Royce Wiles is an Indologist who completed a PhD at the Australian National University (~1995–2000), where he also held a post.

Ruben L. F. Habito is a Buddhist studies and religious studies scholar. He earned his doctorate at the University of Tokyo (~1972–1978) under Akira Hirakawa and Jikido Takasaki, and held posts at Sophia University (~1978–1989) and Southern Methodist University (1989).
Rudolf Hildebrand was a linguist who studied at Thomasschule zu Leipzig (~1836–1843). He held a post at Leipzig University from ~1869 to 1894.

Rudolf von Roth was an Indologist and linguist who studied under Heinrich Ewald at Tübinger Stift (~1839–1843) and Eugène Burnouf at the University of Paris (1843). He held a professorship at the University of Tübingen from 1848 to 1895.

Ruixuan Chen is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and Iranian and Central Asian studies. He completed a PhD at Leiden University (~2013–2018) under doctoral supervisor Paul Harrison and held a post at Heidelberg University (~2021).
